name: deep-crawl
description: Recursively crawl a website using headless Chrome (CDP). Renders JavaScript, follows same-origin links via BFS, extracts text from each page, and saves results to disk.
author: octos

tools.name: deep_crawl
tools.description: Recursively crawl an existing website using a headless browser (CDP). Renders JavaScript, follows same-origin links via BFS, respects robots.txt, extracts text from each page, and saves results to disk. Ideal for ingesting JS-rendered SPAs and documentation sites. NOT for site generation or publishing - use `mofa_site` for site creation and `mofa_publish` for site deployment.

max_depth.description: Maximum link-following depth (range: 0-10, 0 = only the start page, default: 3)

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl (range: 1-200, default: 50)

path_prefix.description: Only follow links under this path prefix (e.g. /docs/)

include_html.description: Also return each crawled page's rendered HTML and final URL in a `pages` array (default: false)
